name: chip-a
prompt: Locked-off static camera on a tripod: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no rotation. The green circuit board chip and its four black glass dies stay perfectly still and keep their exact shape and position. Only the light is alive: the golden light rays behind the chip slowly shimmer and breathe, fine dust drifts through the beams, the green and red rim lights along the gold pins pulse gently, and a soft highlight glides slowly across the four black glass dies. Subtle, cinematic, painted comic style kept exactly.
